修改界面语言不会影响模型、数据源或本地数据。: Changing the display language does not affect models, providers or local data.
登录后自动在后台运行: Start in the background on login
关闭主窗口时保留托盘与后台同步: Keep tray and background sync when the main window closes
监测文件变化并自动同步: Watch file changes and sync automatically
使用配置的 AI 服务自动提炼知识: Use the configured AI model to extract knowledge
Raw Session 同步成功后自动进入处理队列: Queue successfully imported sessions for processing
关闭时继续使用关键词检索；开启后融合关键词与向量召回: When disabled, keyword search remains available; when enabled, keyword and vector results are combined.
暂无可显示的扫描来源数据。: No scanned source data to display.
搜索工具名称或数据目录…: Search tool name or data directory…
搜索当前页工作记录: Search work records on this page
搜索当前页标题、会话 ID 或项目…: Search this page by title, session ID or project…
正在检索知识并组织回答…: Searching knowledge and composing a response…
默认 1（保守）；vLLM 可先尝试 2 路并观察 tokens/s、显存和超时: Default is 1 (conservative). For vLLM, try 2 workers while monitoring tokens/s, GPU memory and timeouts. More concurrency may not be faster. Restart required.
配置保存并重启后搜索服务才会切换模型；历史数据需执行一次“重建语义索引”。重建期: The search service switches models after saving and restarting. Rebuild the semantic index for existing records; keyword search remains available during the rebuild.
AIKS 当前只提交文本；LCO 的图片、音频、视频能力不会被调用。: AIKS currently sends text only; LCO image, audio and video capabilities are not used.
Ollama 原生地址填写 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api: For native Ollama, use http://127.0.0.1:11434/api; OpenAI-compatible endpoints usually end with /v1.
Responses 使用 /v1 地址，Ollama 原生使用 /api 地址。: Responses uses a /v1 endpoint; native Ollama uses /api.
AI 服务、模型、同步周期、内容规则和语义搜索配置保存后需重启 AIKS 后生效: Changes to AI endpoints, models, sync intervals, content rules and semantic search take effect after restarting AIKS; startup and tray settings take effect immediately.
同步源数据中的 thinking 内容: Include thinking content from imported sessions
记录 AI 执行的工具调用: Record tool calls made by AI assistants
自动过滤 API Key、Token 等敏感信息: Automatically filter sensitive data such as API keys and tokens
状态尚未加载。这里不会把未知的统计值显示成 0。: Status is not loaded. Unknown statistics are not shown as zero.
AI 知识条目统计读取失败，请刷新重试；此处不再使用旧提炼表的成功数替代。: Failed to load AI knowledge item statistics. Refresh to retry; counts from the old extraction table are not substituted.
同步状态合计超过本地总会话，可能存在重复目标记录，需要进一步检查。: Sync status counts exceed local sessions and may include duplicate target records.
任务统计获取失败，当前显示为未知；请刷新重试。: Could not load task statistics. The current value is unknown; refresh to retry.
AI 用量读取失败，请刷新重试。: Failed to load AI usage statistics. Refresh to retry.
模型用量需要独立采集真实的输入、输出 Token，暂不使用知识分块的 token: Model usage requires real input and output token counts. Knowledge-chunk token counts are not used as a substitute.
扫描发现与本地会话可能因去重、过滤及来源变化存在差异。两者的差额不能直接认定为漏: Discovered and stored session counts may differ due to deduplication, filtering or provider changes. Differences alone do not prove missing sync; reconcile by provider and session ID.
当前统计未发现同步冲突或异常任务；这不代表所有会话已经完成 AI 处理。: Current statistics show no sync conflicts or abnormal tasks; this does not mean every session has completed AI processing.
概览状态读取中或不可用。: Overview status is loading or unavailable.
任务统计不可用，请检查处理中心。: Task statistics unavailable. Check Processing Center.
本地工作记录、来源发现、同步状态与 AI 处理进度（分别统计）: Local work records, source discovery, sync state and AI processing progress (counted separately)
以下项目来自同一批已入库会话的 SiYuan 同步状态: These metrics reflect SiYuan sync states for the same stored session set.
队列状态独立于“待同步”；任务数量不应与同步状态相加: Queue status is separate from Pending Sync; do not add queue totals to sync counts.
来自本地模型请求日志的累计用量；未返回 usage 的请求不做估算: Accumulated usage from local model request logs; requests without usage data are not estimated.
基于提炼记录的状态统计；不等于有效知识条目数，也不代表模型 Token 消耗: Extraction status counts are not equal to active knowledge items or model token usage.
按 Provider 实时扫描数量排列；不代表已经同步入库的数量: Sorted by live provider scan count; not equivalent to sessions stored in the database.
仅列出已有统计可以证实的问题，不推测未知故障原因: Shows only issues supported by available statistics; does not speculate about unknown failures.
数据根目录（每行一个；固定目录工具留空可自动探测）: Data root directories (one per line; leave blank to detect fixed-path providers)
只读取会话和必要元数据。保存只修改当前数据源设置，重启生效；关闭来源不会删除已导: Only reads sessions and required metadata. Saving updates provider settings and takes effect after a restart; disabling a provider does not delete imported records.
没有符合筛选条件的数据源，可清空搜索或关闭“仅异常”。: No providers match these filters. Clear the search or disable Issues only.
填写包含会话存储的绝对目录，而不是安装目录: Enter the absolute directory containing session data, not the installation directory.
统一管理 AI 工具本地会话来源；健康状态不由会话数量推断。: Manage local AI tool session providers in one place; provider health is not inferred from session counts.
读取数据库来源失败，请刷新页面重试。: Failed to read database source information. Refresh to retry.
支持 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、豆包、Kim: Supports public share URLs from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Doubao, Kimi, Yuanbao and Qwen.
仅支持公开分享链接。需要网页渲染或遇到验证时，AIKS 会自动打开临时窗口，完成: Only public share links are supported. If rendering or verification is required, AIKS opens a temporary window and resumes importing afterward.
无法连接当前配置的 AI 服务: Cannot connect to the configured AI service
系统组件、知识工作台与迁移状态: System components, knowledge workspace and migration status
各组件最近一次检测状态: Most recent check for each component
SiYuan Kernel、Bridge 与知识内容迁移状态: SiYuan Kernel, Bridge and knowledge-migration status
仅在明确点击后执行本地操作: Local operations run only after explicit user action.
基于知识与 AI 对话记录检索回答，并提供可追溯引用: Search knowledge and AI conversation records, then answer with traceable citations.
有什么想从 AIKS 里找的？: What would you like to find in AIKS?
我会先检索知识与历史 AI 对话，再基于证据回答。: I'll search knowledge and past AI conversations before answering from evidence.
AI 服务当前不可用，请先在设置中检查模型配置。: AI service unavailable. Check model settings first.
没有可核实的完整回答。请检查模型服务后重试。: No verifiable complete answer was returned. Check the model service and try again.
Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行 · 基于检索证据回答: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for new line · Evidence-grounded answers
AIKS 可能生成不准确内容，重要结论请结合引用来源核验: AIKS may generate inaccurate information. Verify important conclusions against the cited sources.
尝试使用不同的关键词，或先处理更多工作记录: Try different keywords, or process more work records first.
输入关键词搜索知识库: Enter keywords to search your knowledge base
支持全文搜索，包括标题、摘要、内容和标签: Full-text search includes titles, summaries, content and tags.
搜索本地知识库中的技术结论与历史记录: Search technical conclusions and past work in the local knowledge base
会话同步与 AI 任务状态: Session sync and AI task states
下列状态分别来自同步记录与知识提炼流水线；会话同步成功不代表 AI 知识已提炼完: These states are sourced separately from sync records and the knowledge-extraction pipeline. A successful session sync does not imply AI extraction is complete.
出现文档冲突时仅支持打开会话人工核查，AIKS 不会自动覆盖 SiYuan 中用: When a document conflict occurs, open the session for manual review. AIKS will not automatically overwrite user changes in SiYuan.
以下是上次成功刷新时的任务快照，状态可能已变化，重试与取消暂不可用。: This is a snapshot from the last successful refresh. States may have changed, and retry/cancel actions are temporarily unavailable.
此诊断包仅含全库统计及当前分页任务的匿名化聚合。\n: This diagnostic package contains only database-wide statistics and anonymized aggregates from the current task page. No session or task IDs, titles, paths, source content, error text or secrets are exported. Polling does not silently modify this snapshot.
会话同步、AI 提炼与知识处理流水线状态: Session sync, AI extraction and knowledge-processing pipeline states
查找会话标题、来源或错误内容…: Search session titles, sources or error messages…
查看已入库的会话详情，不改变同步或 AI 排队状态: View stored session details without changing sync or AI queue status.
打开会话核查来源和目标，保留 SiYuan 用户改动；不会自动覆盖: Open the session to review source and target; preserve user changes in SiYuan.
目前没有可用的项目 Session，先同步本地工作记录。: No project sessions are available yet. Sync local work records first.
人工修正项目归属（仅 AIKS 本地）: Manually correct project assignment (AIKS local only)
仅将选中的 Session 归入一个已经发现真实绝对路径的项目，适用于无路径或识: Assign the selected session to a project with a verified absolute path. This is intended for missing or incorrectly detected paths. Provider files, original session paths and SiYuan documents will not be modified. Undo to restore the automatic grouping.
当前 Session 有用户手动归属记录；可使用「撤销归属修正」恢复。: This session has a manual project assignment. Use Undo assignment correction to restore the original grouping.
按既有知识类别整理，不从对话猜测已完成事项、待办或事实矛盾。统计仅覆盖当前有界样: Organized by existing knowledge categories. No completed work, tasks or contradictions are inferred from conversations. Statistics cover the current bounded sample only.
仅查看需要人工复核的知识（基于用户反馈）: Show knowledge requiring manual review (based on user feedback)
时间线使用知识最后更新时间，并非问题发生或决策生效时间；请点击原始 Sessio: The timeline uses the last knowledge update time, not when an incident occurred or a decision took effect. Check the original session.
当前筛选范围内暂无知识证据。: No knowledge evidence in the current filter.
当前仅展示有界样本，不代表全部项目历史；主题统计和时间线均可能不完整。: Only a bounded sample is shown, not the full project history. Topic counts and timeline may be incomplete.
仅汇总用户明确反馈和当前项目中已有来源验证的修正、替代、解决关系。\n: Aggregates explicit user feedback and source-verified correction, replacement and resolution relations in this project. AIKS does not automatically infer contradictions, staleness or factual truth from similar titles or model summaries; confirming a relation does not validate an engineering conclusion. Further edits, archiving and reviews require explicit user action and do not modify provider or SiYuan originals.
当前复核队列仅覆盖已有的有界知识/关系列表，且最多展示最近 100 条；\n: The review queue covers only bounded knowledge and relation lists, with at most 100 recent items. No visible review signals does not mean the project has no risks.
当前项目没有已提交的质量反馈或修正、替代、解决关系，因此复核队列为空。这不代表知: This project has no submitted quality feedback or correction, replacement or resolution relations, so the review queue is empty. That does not mean all knowledge is verified; review tasks are not created automatically from AI confidence. Open Knowledge Details to submit incorrect, outdated, duplicate or incomplete feedback.
仅显示带来源证据、由用户确认或尚待确认的「修正 / 替代 / 解决」关系。\n: Displays source-backed correction, replacement and resolution relations that are confirmed or pending human confirmation. Relation dates indicate review updates, not when solutions took effect. Old knowledge and sessions remain available.
当前项目没有可展示的人工确认或待确认演进关系；这并不证明不存在知识矛盾。: No confirmed or pending evolution relations are displayed for this project. This does not prove there are no knowledge contradictions.
仅展示最近 100 条关系，不代表项目全部历史。: Only the 100 most recent relations are shown, not the entire project history.
先生成可编辑预览，再复制使用。不会自动写入项目文件或外部服务。: Generate an editable preview before copying. Nothing is written automatically to project files or external services.
人工精选 Agent 知识包（最多 30 条）: Curated agent knowledge pack (up to 30 items)
从当前项目可追溯的知识中手工选取具体条目；不会把相似标题当作同一来源。\n: Select specific, traceable knowledge items from this project. Similar titles are not treated as the same source. Items marked incorrect or outdated cannot be selected. The backend revalidates every selected ID against project and source. The output is only a Markdown/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md proposal requiring review, not a write to instruction files.
当前项目知识超过 200 条，只能从已经加载的证据中选择；不代表全部知识均已审阅: This project has over 200 knowledge items. Only loaded evidence can be selected; this does not mean all items have been reviewed.
生成所选知识的 Agent 背景预览: Preview agent context from selected knowledge
本地回顾草稿与历史修订: Local review drafts and revision history
已审核的 Markdown 可显式保存到当前 AIKS 数据库；再次保存追加修订: Reviewed Markdown can be explicitly saved in the local AIKS database. Saving again appends a revision without overwriting previous manual edits or sending content to SiYuan, email or providers. Up to 100 recent reports are shown.
沿项目路径汇集知识证据、追踪知识演进；同名项目不会自动合并。: Organize source-backed knowledge and track evolution by project path. Projects with the same name are not automatically merged.
用户管理 · AI 不再覆盖: User-managed · AI will no longer overwrite
这条知识由你直接在 AIKS 中创建，没有绑定外部工作记录。: You created this knowledge item directly in AIKS; it is not linked to an external work record.
所有关系先记录为建议，人工确认后才成为已确认的知识关联；原知识不会被自动删除或覆: All relations are proposed first and become confirmed only after human review. Original knowledge is never automatically deleted or overwritten. Cross-provider relations require the same verified project path or explicit manual assignment; matching project names alone are not evidence. Missing source records cannot be confirmed.
候选仅供检索（最多最近 200 条），并不表示具备合法关联范围；提交建议与人工确: Candidates are for lookup only (up to 200 recent entries), not proof of valid relation scope. The Rust backend independently verifies both knowledge sources when proposing or confirming a relation.
按关系更新时间排序；仅“已确认”代表人工确认的关联，其他状态不作为确定的演进事实: Sorted by relation update time; only Confirmed denotes a human-verified association. Other states are not established evolution facts.
暂无已确认的演进关系；未确认或已拒绝的关系保留在下方审核区。: No confirmed evolution relations yet. Pending or rejected relations remain in the review section below.
显示关系状态由「建议」到「确认」或「拒绝」的人工审核轨迹；审核时间不等于知识生效: Shows human review history as relations move from Proposed to Confirmed or Rejected. Review time does not imply when knowledge became effective. Records are not automatically removed after project reassignment, rejected proposals or archiving.
尚无本知识的关系人工审核记录。: No relation review history for this item.
仅展示最近 100 次审核，历史记录可能更多。: Only the 100 most recent reviews are displayed; older records may exist.
反馈只保存在本地，不会自动删除知识或覆盖人工编辑。: Feedback is stored locally and does not automatically delete knowledge or overwrite manual edits.
生成建议只预览、不写入；确认「创建」会在 SiYuan 新增独立文档，不覆盖原文: Generated proposals are preview-only. Confirming Create adds a separate SiYuan document without overwriting originals. Archiving or restoring changes local AIKS state only and does not delete SiYuan documents. Re-review is required if sources change.
可选的其他知识来源（最多 4 条，Ctrl/Command 可多选）: Optional additional knowledge sources (up to 4, Ctrl/Command to select multiple)
本地知识可先生成草稿；创建新知识需要 SiYuan 可用，并会新增独立 SiYu: You can generate a local draft first. Creating new knowledge requires SiYuan availability, creates a separate SiYuan document and leaves originals intact.
多来源比较/合并的差异视图一次仅对照一份真实原文；每份来源的内容必须分别核对，\: The multi-source comparison/diff view compares one original source at a time. Review each source separately; a diff against the primary knowledge does not mean other sources were reviewed. Open each source and read the original. Review covers only the visible draft; Rust revalidates every source before creation.
请逐一打开所有来源，才能确认多来源整理草稿。: Open and review every source before confirming a multi-source draft.
与当前选中的来源知识正文按行对照：+ 为新草稿增加，− 为原正文没有保留，\n: Line-by-line comparison against the selected source: + means added in the draft; − means omitted from the original; unmarked lines are unchanged. This is review assistance only and does not modify original knowledge. Creating always adds a separate SiYuan document.
内容相同（换行风格差异忽略）: Content is identical (ignoring line ending differences)
差异预览已截断（最多 320 行/单侧、500 行展示），\n: The diff preview is truncated (up to 320 lines per side, 500 displayed lines). Hidden content may still differ; continue reviewing the full original and draft above.
我已核对原文与草稿，理解复制不写入、确认创建会新增独立 SiYuan 文档。: I reviewed the original and draft and understand that copying does not write, while confirming creation adds a separate SiYuan document.
确认创建新的 SiYuan 知识文档（不覆盖原文）: Confirm creation of a new SiYuan knowledge document (without overwriting the original)
已确认 SiYuan 文档存在、但审计记录缺失时，可以只修复本地审核来源。\n: When a SiYuan document is confirmed to exist but its audit record is missing, repair only the local review provenance. Verify the organization method and original knowledge above and enter an existing knowledge ID. The backend checks the local SiYuan binding, review marker and source order; it does not query SiYuan for current document state. This operation does not create another SiYuan document.
此处读取本地持久审核记录；关闭或重开程序后仍可找到从当前知识衍生的独立文档。\n: These review records are stored locally and survive app restarts. Derived independent documents can be found later. Archive/restore changes AIKS state only, never deleting SiYuan documents or original sessions. Up to 100 recent entries are shown.
尚无本地持久的知识整理审核记录。: No persisted local knowledge organization review history.
写明来源 Session、消息区间或判断依据（必填）: Describe the source session, message range or reasoning (required)
待修复审计的现有知识 ID: Existing knowledge ID for audit repair
发布到 SiYuan 请进入知识详情: Open knowledge details to publish to SiYuan
可以从工作记录自动提炼，也可以直接在 AIKS 中新建。: Knowledge can be automatically extracted from work records or created manually in AIKS.
AI 提炼与手工知识统一管理；SiYuan 是可选发布目标。: Manage AI-extracted and manually created knowledge together; SiYuan is an optional publishing destination.

这条知识尚未绑定 Canonical SiYuan 文档，将由内容迁移流程处理。: This item is not yet bound to a canonical SiYuan document; the content migration will handle it.
在系统默认浏览器打开当前 SiYuan: Open the current SiYuan site in the default browser
搜索当前页知识标题或摘要…: Search knowledge title or summary on this page…
同步数据后，AI 将自动整理有价值的会话: After syncing, AI can extract useful knowledge from sessions
或点击数据源中的「立即整理」: Or choose Process now in Data Sources
处理记录尚未就绪，请刷新重试。: Processing record is not ready yet. Refresh to retry.
原始内容统一在知识库的 AI 对话记录中浏览、搜索和引用。工作记录页只保留来源、: Original content is browsed, searched and cited from AI Conversation Records in the knowledge base. Work Records only shows management data such as sources, processing state and extraction results.
该工作记录尚未绑定具体 SiYuan 文档，将打开“AI 对话记录”根目录。: This work record is not yet bound to a specific SiYuan document. The AI Conversation Records root will be opened.
